rotation.method: Unattended-run override: working set = ALL 3 core + ENTIRE 34-keyword medicine pool (37 total), no rotation subset. Rotation only sets EMPHASIS: today's 17 emphasized keywords get dedicated queries; yesterday's 17 (indices 0-10, 28-33) are grouped into shared multi-keyword queries so every keyword is still covered. 10-20 published Medical AI AiTiALVSD ECG LVSD FDA 510(k), NEJM AI AI-INFOCARE pre-visit lay-summary RCT (Simply Onno), JACR/HPI radiologist workforce editorial, OUD-REY opioid use disorder EHR deep learning (All of Us / VA), and Lunit SCOPE SITC 2026 ovarian/bladder IO abstracts - so AI-ECG, patient-communication RCT, EHR risk-prediction and Lunit expansions are steered to different angles. No WebSearch used in planning.
rotation.notes: Scope per sources.json categories[medicine]._note: clinical/treatment only - trials and results, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/CE approvals, hospital/clinic deployment and care operations, diagnosis/imaging, disease-specific drug discovery (preclinical OK if a disease is named), device software, EHR/documentation, telehealth, prior-auth automation, patient safety/bias/liability. Disease-unspecified biology / protein-structure models / benchmarks belong to science - drop unless a named disease, patient, clinician or institution is reached; never put one story in both sections. Exclude funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, evidence-free wellness-app promos. SAFETY: never pick a story readable as pathogen gain-of-function or bioweapon design - swap it, do not reword. Antibiotic and vaccine queries are framed therapeutically (treating resistant infections, cancer vaccines).

plan_notes: For the librarian: (1) LEAD WITH OUTLET RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds for recency (statnews, fiercehealthcare, fiercebiotech, healthcareitnews, mobihealthnews, medcitynews, endpts, biopharmadive, healthcaredive, radiologybusiness, auntminnie, healthimaging, beckershospitalreview, medpagetoday, digitalhealth.net, kffhealthnews, nature.com Nature Medicine / npj Digital Medicine / Communications Medicine, ai.nejm.org, jamanetwork, bmj, thelancet Digital Health, fda.gov press, cms.gov newsroom, gov.uk, dailypharm, docdocdoc, medigatenews, bosa). WebSearch site: queries tend to return evergreen pages - use the queries above to fill gaps. (2) WINDOW: 14 days (published 2026-10-07 through 2026-10-21); verify each item's published timestamp - JAMA RSS dates are issue dates (confirm via Crossref), Korean feeds are KST without offset. (3) Follow sources.json categories[medicine]._note: patient/clinician/regulator-facing only; disease-unspecified biology goes to science, never both sections; drop funding/M&A/personnel, supplement ads, wellness promos. (4) SAFETY: no pathogen gain-of-function / bioweapon-readable stories - drop and replace, do not reword; antibiotic/vaccine items must be therapeutic (treatment of resistant infection, cancer vaccines). (5) DO NOT RESUBMIT rotation.recently_published_avoid.headlines (10-20: AiTiALVSD 510(k); NEJM AI AI-INFOCARE RCT; JACR HPI radiologist workforce editorial; OUD-REY; Lunit SITC 2026; plus 10-12..10-19 list) nor same-event follow-ups without a new decision/result. (6) Today's emphasis: prior auth/insurance, AI therapy chatbots, specialty AI (derm/eye/cardio/onc RT), AI-designed biologics/antibiotics/cancer vaccines in named diseases, surgery, bias/safety/liability, LLM CDS, genomics/rare disease, telehealth, nursing; aim for spread and at least one Korean-source item. (7) Write candidates under the key "items" (not "candidates").
